calls.title: AGNI: fall reading period (includes review essays)
calls.pay: $30 per printed page for prose (reviews paid as prose), up to $300, plus a one-year subscription; free to submit reviews/pitches
calls.details: Deadline Dec 15, 11:59pm ET (reopens Jan 15 - May 31, 2027). No submission fee for book reviews or review pitches ($3 online fee applies only to general non-review submissions). Review essays 1,500-3,000 words; simultaneous submissions ok with notice; conflict-of-interest disclosure required.

calls.title: Still Point: poetry-book reviews (March issue)
calls.details: Complete, copyedited review of a recent poetry collection, 750-1,500 words, by email.

calls.title: The Wire: New Voices competition for emerging music critics
calls.pay: Winner: £250, publication in the March 2027 issue and a digital subscription; free to enter
calls.details: Send a 500-word review (recent album, book, festival, gig, film or exhibition in The Wire's territory) plus a 500-word opinion piece on 'Music criticism is irrelevant in contemporary culture'. For writers with no more than three paid music pieces published. One entry each, attachments only (.doc/.rtf/.pdf), no AI. Closes midnight GMT.

calls.title: The Threepenny Review: reading period (critical articles)
calls.pay: $400 per article; $200 per Table Talk piece
calls.details: Critical articles about 1,200-2,500 words on books, films, theater, art: each review should read as an essay broader than its occasion. Online or mailed submissions only, never email. Closed Apr 15-Dec 31.

calls.title: The Common: expanded book-review section wants reviewers
calls.details: Reviews of place-centred books from small independent presses released within the last three months; no self-published books. Pitch a review or propose a book via the form on the page.

calls.title: Drafting the Past: history book reviews (pitching Dec 2026 / Jan 2027 titles)
calls.pay: $200 per single-book review; more for review essays
calls.details: Nonfiction history only. Pitch at least three months before publication; as of its latest note it is taking pitches for books out in December 2026/January 2027 or later. Up to 1,000 words (essays up to 1,500).

calls.title: Grain: call for pitches for short book reviews
calls.details: 450-word book reviews (also 900-word interviews and craft essays). Email pitch, 250-word outline max; rolling.

calls.title: Ancillary Review of Books: calls for reviews & essays, January 2027 titles
calls.pay: $50 for standard reviews (700-1,000 words); $75 for short essays (1,500-2,000 words); $100 for longer essays (2,500-3,000 words)
calls.details: Speculative fiction, cultural studies, and translated lit; lists January 2027 titles and invites series, re-reads, and ARB Guides. Year 7 honoraria paid first week of month after publication; no kill fee; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; no generative AI at any stage. Pitch via form after reading style guide.

calls.title: The Markaz Review: MIS/TRANSLATION themed issue (essays, translator's notes, reviews)
calls.pay: Honorarium paid within 30 days of publication (NBCC sheet lists $120)
calls.details: Works in translation and essays about the craft of translation, mistranslation, and translator's notes via Duosuma. Regular weekly book review pitches remain open year-round.

calls.title: WritersReview: rolling book reviewer applications (12 genres)
calls.details: Rolling reviewer application on /write-for-us/. Minimum 1,500 words of original critical analysis across 12 genres (Literary Fiction, Sci-Fi, Biography, History, Poetry, Philosophy & more). Prioritizes reviewers with a published book or editing/acquisitions experience; editors assign books in your specialty. $0 fee.

calls.title: Strange Horizons: 2027 criticism special (essays, long reviews, roundtables)
calls.pay: Standing rates: $150 original essay; $60 review (1,000+ words); $20 per roundtable contributor
calls.details: Annual SF/fantasy criticism special publishing at the end of January 2027. Call (posted on its Bluesky 16 Oct 2026) invites essays, long reviews, roundtables or any "critical thing" - email reviews@strangehorizons.com. No firm deadline stated; pitch soon given the late-January publication.

calls.title: MQR Online: year-round pitches for book reviews, essays, interviews
calls.details: Brief pitch or submission via the free MQR Online Submittable form; the Online Editor invites selected pitches to submit a full piece of up to 3,000 words.

calls.title: Sydney Review of Books: JUNCTURE Fellowship for mid-career critics (3 x $7,000)
calls.pay: AUD $7,000 per fellow: three longform essays at $2,000 each plus $1,000 editorial fee; Varuna residency Feb 1-8, 2027
calls.details: Closes noon Monday Nov 23 (Sydney time). Australian residents and Australian nationals abroad; mid-career = 3-4+ years of strong critical publications. Apply via SRB Submittable with cover letter (up to 1,000 words, sketching three essay pitches on Australian literature), 3 writing samples and a CV of up to 3 pages. One fellowship prioritised for a First Nations and/or CaLD writer. Each fellow also commissions and edits one longform piece.

calls.title: thINKingDANCE: 2027 Emerging Writer's Fellowship (dance criticism, US undergraduates)
calls.pay: $500 unrestricted stipend plus publication and 3 hours of 1:1 mentorship
calls.details: Two US-based undergraduates. Apply with one writing sample (arts analysis, performance criticism or creative writing, 500 words max) and a brief cover letter; any dance genre; hybrid forms welcome. Fellows either develop the sample or pitch a new piece, published by end of Spring 2027. Selections announced early December 2026.

calls.title: The Ex-Puritan: book reviews for the Winter 2027 issue
calls.details: Reviews of Canadian literature (esp. marginalized and debut authors) via Submittable; a fully thought-out pitch is acceptable instead of a draft. Free category has a monthly cap; a $3 fee category stays open. Submissions received by Dec 25 are considered for the February issue; decisions within 4 months. Pays in CAD by e-transfer, PayPal or cheque only.

calls.title: Another Chicago Magazine: book reviews (small & university presses)
calls.details: Reviews of fiction and creative nonfiction books/collections from small and university presses, forthcoming or released within the calendar year; no children's/YA. Pay not stated on the page. Deadline Dec 1 per the submissions page.

calls.title: AICA-USA Art Critic Fellowship 2027 (emerging art critics, US/Puerto Rico, age 24+)
calls.pay: $750 stipend plus $250 on publication; free to attend; mentorship and workshops Jan 10 - Apr 4, 2027
calls.details: Develop a piece of art criticism with a mentor for publication on the AICA-USA site; hybrid program; US/Puerto Rico residents 24+; W-9 eligible. Finalists notified mid-December 2026. Deadline Nov 22 is from the Call for Curators listing; the AICA-USA page itself did not show it in the fetch.
